description: Connect ChatGPT to the data your organization has configured in Alteryx One. Explore business questions in plain language, get trusted answers grounded in governed data, and move from "what's happening?" to "what should we look at next?" without switching tools. Use Alteryx One to understand business performance, investigate drivers, prepare updates, and make faster decisions from the data your team already relies on.
